_about: The story turn (story-mode, signed by the parent 2026-10-30): the rule of her words — intent.py of bake-off 2, its story and invent branches, over her words normalized (lower case, «ё» as «е», no ъ and ь, marks as spaces): {ask} and {object} are put into the patterns; invent goes first, a game in it stays the game's; bridges — the signed phrases by kind, in a circle from the wake; exchanges — how many last turns the model of tales reads; selftest — probes of the rule (want: story, invent, or none); off — the console line when the mode is off.

selftest.text: Элли, расскажи мне сказку про дракона.

А ты знаешь сказку про репку?
